connector.name: grad-agent
connector.registryDescription: Autonomous MCP agent for grad school applications: prof discovery, cold emails, SOP, tracking.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package grad-agent. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the i-ninte account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.description: Anthropic API key used by Claude Haiku for hook synthesis and verification.

env.name: SMTP_SERVER
env.description: SMTP host for the review mailer.

env.name: SMTP_USERNAME
env.description: SMTP username; used as From address by default.

env.name: SMTP_PASSWORD
env.description: SMTP password. Gmail App Password recommended.

env.name: SMTP_FROM
env.description: Envelope From address for drafts emailed to the user's review inbox.

env.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
env.description: Optional. Personal access token used to enumerate the user's public and private GitHub repos during catalog sync.

env.name: HF_TOKEN
env.description: Optional. HuggingFace token used to enumerate the user's published models and datasets during catalog sync.

env.name: GRAD_AGENT_HOME
env.description: Optional. Override the default ~/.grad-agent/ location for profile, programs, secrets, and data.
